headline: FCC Blocks Devices Containing Huawei Surveillance Chips From US Market
summary: The Federal Communications Commission has moved to block electronic devices containing surveillance chips made by Huawei from being imported or sold in the United States.
why: The FCC regulates interstate and international communications, using equipment authorization rules to restrict technology hardware linked to foreign security risks.

impacts.name: US Telecommunications Equipment
impacts.why: Restrictions on Chinese components alter supply chain compliance requirements for hardware importers.
